title: Marshall Arisman
description: "For my GALAXY trading card, I chose to stay away from the familiar STAR WARS characters," explains Marshall Arisman. "l settled on a portrait of an Ugnaught, one of those little pig-like creatures glimpsed briefly in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK." No stranger to Lucas' space fantasy (he rendered Darth Vader for a 1980 TIME magazine cover), Arisman is an artist whose work evokes strong emotional themes. His paintings and drawings have been widely exhibited both internationally and nationally over the past 20 years. Arisman's political illustrations are regularly seen in the Op-Ed page of THE NEW YORK TIMES, THE NATION, TIME and other important publications.
